title: AlignBench: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Image-Text Alignment with Synthetic Image-Caption Pairs

bias_targets.methodology: Averaging and comparing the Vision-Language Model (VLM) detectors' correctness scores based on the sentence's position within the generated caption to determine if evaluators assign higher scores to sentences appearing near the beginning of the output regardless of actual correctness.

Comparing the performance (AUROC and correctness scores) of VLM evaluators when judging their own generated captions versus captions generated by other models, to identify if models systematically favor their own outputs and fail to detect their own hallucinations.
